_comment: String allowlist for scripts/leakscan.py (DESIGN 13.4 (i)). Each entry exempts one exact literal in one exact file (repo-relative path) and nowhere else; every allowlisted occurrence is printed as an EXEMPT line. Only identifiers that collide with HGNC symbols and are not gene references belong here. Gene symbols used as genes (e.g. scripts/build_cgt.py) must move to config, never here. ACH- ids cannot be allowlisted.

allow.reason: dictionary family id FUS (fusion features, DESIGN 3), not the FUS gene
dictionary family id COMP (P1 composite flags, DESIGN 3), not the COMP gene
suffix test for the spectrum id SIG:SPEC_POLE (DESIGN 3), not a POLE gene feature
family id FUS in the GENE_FAMILIES set (DESIGN 3), not the FUS gene
family id COMP mapped to build_params composite_features (DESIGN 3), not the COMP gene
name of the TP53-status covariate column (DESIGN 5.3), not a gene feature
family id FUS used as a dictionary key and in the family description table (DESIGN 3)
family id COMP in the family description table (DESIGN 3)
status word printed for a checksum mismatch ('OK'/'BAD'), not the BAD gene
